eligibility.at_issuance: finite nonnegative TS3 and valid join/date/topic
eligibility.missing_predictors: negative/nonfinite TS1 or TS2: training-median imputation plus missing indicators
eligibility.target_unavailable: retain availability record; no outcome imputation
eligibility.conflicting_duplicate_ids: News conflict based only on IDLink,PublishDate,Topic,Title,Headline,Source; social conflict only IDLink and normalized TS1/TS2/TS3. Conflicting early information excludes ID. Identical early information collapses; conflicting TS144 retains issuance-eligible ID with unavailable label. Never average labels. Ignore TS4..143 and final metadata popularity for eligibility.
eligibility.failure_policy: retain failure without replacement, resplit, new seed or model changes

target.rank_target: global centered-midrank covariance after exact category conditional-mean adjustment on uniform observed-label selection archive

baseline: ridge alpha10 SVD with first-hour popularity history and calendar

controls.breakpoints: three training-baseline quartiles, linear quantile, repeated cuts retained
controls.probabilities: exact observed-label selection-archive census; all metadata costs charged

selection.rule: lowest selection-loss retained augmentation only if strictly better than baseline
selection.ties: baseline first, then fixed family order
selection.adjustment: Benjamini-Yekutieli complete family of six separately for each method

sampling.streams: numpy.SeedSequence(seed).spawn(3); train, validation pairs, evaluation; one shared call sequence for all candidates/methods

confirmation_inference.hourly_gain: average (loss_comparator-loss_primary) over every issuance-eligible article published in the hour; unavailable-label gain zero, empty hour zero
confirmation_inference.predictable_width: 2*mean(abs(primary-comparator)) over every issuance-eligible article; empty hour zero
confirmation_inference.target: mean E[G_t | information at settlement of the preceding publication hour]; current hour settles at its end+48 hours
confirmation_inference.availability_assumption: Frozen forecasts, issuance eligibility and denominator are measurable at previous-hour settlement; final targets/availability settle by current-hour end+48h. Archive timestamps do not independently establish this historical availability. This is same-period settled-hour conditional-average gain, not issuance-conditioned or unknown-future-period forecasting risk.

implementation.missing_numeric_features: training median, zero if entirely missing; indicators for every numeric column; train-only standardization
implementation.source_levels: 32 most frequent nonempty training source strings; count ties lexical; missing/unseen maps to other
implementation.calendar_hour: fractional nominal publication hour from hour+minute/60+second/3600
implementation.duplicate_conflicts: News conflict based only on IDLink,PublishDate,Topic,Title,Headline,Source; social conflict only IDLink and normalized TS1/TS2/TS3. Conflicting early information excludes ID. Identical early information collapses; conflicting TS144 retains issuance-eligible ID with unavailable label. Never average labels. Ignore TS4..143 and final metadata popularity for eligibility.
implementation.ingestion_visibility: All raw labels are ingested before stage files are separated. This reproduction does not claim blind custody.
